scope: Read-only physical_v1; no training/rollouts or frozen edits. No attachment evidence. Paths are repo-relative.

equations.action: q=Qmax*a0 MW; b=2*rmcp_max*a1 USD/MWh; a0,a1 in [0,1], rmcp_max=100.
equations.acceptance: p=sigmoid(0.15*(r-b))*min(1,R/max(q,0.01)); A=1[U<p]. Accepted: c=q,rate=r. Rejected: c=D,rate=d; default DR D=5 MW,d=5 USD/MW-h. No partial clearing.
equations.settlement: h=executed_steps*5/3600; e=mean absolute tracking error (kW); F=macro tracking floor (kW). Revenue=rate*c*h*max(0,1-e/max(1000*c,F)); electricity=sum LMP*(Pfacility-Pbess)*dt_hours. Cash=revenue-electricity. Uniform posted clearing, NOT pay-as-bid.
equations.old_reward: Revenue/1000+mean(low_reward)-0.5*electricity/1000-0.05*abs(a0-a0_previous). Dimensionless low rewards and half-weighted electricity do not optimize cash.

findings: For fixed q and price-independent conditional values, V=V_DR+p*(V_q-V_DR): b=0 is optimal if acceptance helps, b=200 if harmful. Intermediate prices randomize admission without a premium. Relative-price fixes conditioning, not economics.

Oversized bids clear in full. Above R, E[Aq] plateaus but E[c]=D+s*R*(1-D/q) increases with q (s=price sigmoid). Perfect-tracking revenue can rise through extra DR fallback payments. Accepted q=0 cancels DR. These are mechanism edge cases.
Old rule uses 0.8*r and ignores SOC/R. Repricing gains need no RL. Residual-to-rule is a useful prior, not extra control: high level cannot directly target SOC while low1007 is unchanged.

SOC penalty is 0.5 only below 0.12; service gate is terminal SOC>=0.20. Four macro1006 failures ended at 0.1274-0.1595, outside the penalty region. Recovery cannot repair that gate. Battery rail=0.10, discharge derates below0.20; a throughout-day0.20 floor would be a NEW constraint.
Macro observes current r/R but lagged mean LMP, absolute RegD and no remaining time. RegD is not guaranteed interval-neutral. Lower commitment need not monotonically improve frozen-low SOC.
algebra_probe: Affinity {60}, one-thread project Python, no GPU/environment. Frozen functions: r=42.33,R=18,q=24 gives p=0.748692/0.585544/0.375 at b=0/0.8r/r, same clearing rate; q=0 suppresses DR.

Development +1003 became heldout -12952 USD after recovery (all30 negative). Repricing is not a demonstrated fix. Low1007's +403USD vs PID coexists with worse actual peak relief1.257 vs1.998MW. Neither comparison identifies new-macro gains.
required_baselines: Original rule+low1007; identical quantity logic with b=0 isolates repricing.
Development-tuned constant-quantity grid and load rule at b=0, including min(Qmax,R); oversize bids only in labelled ablation.

Reserve rule: b=0; q=min(q_load,R,q_cap(SOC,thermal,backlog,time)), projected onto common bounds. Development-fit small threshold family with charge/discharge headroom and DR fallback. Zero residual is the RL comparator, same observations/bounds; no safety guarantee.
recommended_protocol: Quantity-only bounded residual around reserve rule; b=0, frozen low1007/market. Common range D<=q<=min(Qmax,R,q_cap); empty range is infeasible. Removes price withdrawal/oversize tricks. Ablate reward, action mapping and reserve changes separately.

Maximize paired undiscounted26h cash versus strongest same-low baseline: service revenue minus metered service+fixed2h recovery electricity. Fold recovery into final reward. No added SOC salvage or invented wear/SLA dollars; report throughput, age and latency.

Require completion, existing service gates, recovery closure, and preregistered noninferiority of committed MW-h, performance-weighted MW-h and biased-stress physical relief versus same-low baseline. Lower RMSE alone cannot excuse withdrawal. Report actual peaks separately.

Give rule/learner clock and causal signed-demand history equally. Gamma=1; true task end has zero continuation. With recovery folded in, do not bootstrap service timeout into reset. Artificial collection timeouts differ.

Negative absolute cash can favor early death by avoiding future bills; no dedicated death cost exists. Require learner-side feasibility/failure constraints, not only terminal masks or checkpoint filters. Never revive faults or rank partial cash as a full day.

Recovery: continuing state, fixed2h, zero service/revenue, initial-SOC and nominal-temperature targets, preserved age/tolerances. Broaden development days/stresses; paired randomness, new disjoint calendar test. Old heldout dates are regression evidence now.
open_decisions: Before training: specify constrained learning, service margins, reserve family and causal observations. Establish frozen-low feasibility; do not assume a quantity cap guarantees it.
Proxy-LMP cash is not real ISO/business profit. No algorithm superiority, training-seed robustness or global safety claim.
